terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.description: IronWork app server on http://localhost:3000 (Vite HMR + /api/pdf + API routes). Chrome for the PDF route is auto-detected at /usr/bin/google-chrome-stable. Placeholder Supabase client vars let the SPA boot the anonymous work-order/preview flow; add real VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY secrets for auth/DB, and SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for the authenticated PDF route.
